resources.string: Only files imported into this profile are used: fill the private key and known hosts paths with the import buttons. Typed paths to other files, for example on shared storage, and tilde or relative paths are refused when connecting. Without an imported known_hosts file, the server\'s key fingerprint is shown for you to confirm on the first connection.
The next connection will show the server\'s fingerprint and ask you to trust it again.
